prompt.en: Friends are making a small, voluntary fashion zine together. What would you most enjoy starting with?
prompt.zh: 朋友自愿合作一本小型穿搭创作刊，你最喜欢先做什么？

label.en: Invite people in an easy way that leaves them free to join or watch.
label.zh: 用轻松方式邀请，让人自由加入或旁观。

label.en: Agree a clear theme and a simple plan for putting the pages together.
label.zh: 约定清楚主题和简单组页计划。

label.en: Write a short fictional piece that explores an ordinary moment in the project.
label.zh: 写篇短虚构作品，琢磨项目的普通片刻。

label.en: Hear different preferences before the group settles on its format.
label.zh: 定刊物形式前，听不同偏好。

prompt.en: Your zine group has many page ideas but no shared shape yet. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 创作刊点子很多，还没共同形状，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Build a coherent page order everyone can discuss and agree.
label.zh: 排一个连贯页序，供大家讨论同意。

label.en: Turn one small imagined scene into a thoughtful paragraph.
label.zh: 把一个想象小场景写成有思考的段落。

label.en: Listen to what each contributor wants the issue to feel like.
label.zh: 听每位创作者希望这期是什么感觉。

label.en: Compare the resources already offered and choose a manageable first version.
label.zh: 比已自愿提供的材料，选可负担初版。

prompt.en: A blank page is available for any original contribution. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 有空白页可放任何原创贡献，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Write fiction from an invented viewpoint without exposing anyone’s private life.
label.zh: 从虚构视角写，不暴露任何人私生活。

label.en: Invite two contributors to explain their different hopes for the page.
label.zh: 邀两位创作者解释对这页的不同期待。

label.en: Choose a page format that fits the time and materials already agreed.
label.zh: 选适合约好时间和材料的页面形式。

label.en: Try a handmade collage or altered-paper fashion idea.
label.zh: 试手作拼贴或纸张改造穿搭点子。

prompt.en: Two friends prefer different covers for the same zine. What would you enjoy doing?
prompt.zh: 两位朋友偏好不同刊物封面，你喜欢做什么？

label.en: Ask each person what they value in their version before suggesting a way forward.
label.zh: 建议下一步前，问各自看重哪部分。

label.en: Check what each cover would require within the group’s agreed limits.
label.zh: 在约好限制内，核每种封面要什么。

label.en: Make a small paper sample that tries an element from each design.
label.zh: 做小纸样，试两种设计各一个元素。

label.en: Keep the conversation welcoming enough that nobody needs to perform popularity.
label.zh: 让交流好加入，不需表演受欢迎。

prompt.en: Only a few shared materials remain for your optional creative issue. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 这期可选创作只剩少量共有材料，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Pick a feasible use for the materials without asking anyone to spend more.
label.zh: 不要求加钱，给材料选可行用途。

label.en: Experiment with scraps to see what an unexpected texture can do.
label.zh: 拿边角料试意外质地能做什么。

label.en: Offer an easy invitation to contribute in whatever way is comfortable.
label.zh: 轻松邀请，让人按舒服方式贡献。

label.en: Revise the page plan so the issue still feels coherent.
label.zh: 改页计划，让这期仍连贯。

prompt.en: An old paper sample could become part of a new fashion illustration. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 旧纸样能变成新穿搭插画的一部分，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Try cutting, folding or layering it into a new visual possibility.
label.zh: 试剪、折、叠，作新视觉可能。

label.en: Share it casually with someone who might enjoy joining in.
label.zh: 轻松分享给可能喜欢参与的人。

label.en: Give the sample a clear place in the issue’s agreed visual theme.
label.zh: 在约好视觉主题中，给纸样清楚位置。

label.en: Write an invented vignette about the object rather than a real person’s secrets.
label.zh: 给物件写虚构小品，不写真人秘密。

prompt.en: A newcomer is curious about your friends’ creative gathering. What would you enjoy offering?
prompt.zh: 新人好奇朋友的创作聚会，你喜欢给什么？

label.en: A relaxed welcome with a genuine option to try a page or simply look around.
label.zh: 放松欢迎，真能选试做一页或随便看看。

label.en: A quick overview of the theme, page order and decisions already agreed.
label.zh: 快速介绍主题、页序和已约定决定。

label.en: A short fictional example that shows one possible contribution.
label.zh: 给一个虚构短例，展示可能贡献。

label.en: A chance to say what interests them before anyone assigns a part.
label.zh: 派任务前，给机会说自己感兴趣什么。

prompt.en: The zine’s pages are individually interesting but feel disconnected. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 刊物每页有趣，彼此却不连贯，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Suggest a shared structure that contributors can adjust together.
label.zh: 建议共同结构，让创作者一起改。

label.en: Write a fictional linking passage that adds another way to read the pages.
label.zh: 写虚构连接段，增加阅读这些页的方法。

label.en: Ask contributors which differences they want the issue to preserve.
label.zh: 问创作者想保留哪些差异。

label.en: Choose a small workable edit using the time everyone has offered.
label.zh: 用大家自愿给的时间，选可做小修改。

prompt.en: You want to contribute writing to a friend-made issue. What feels most appealing?
prompt.zh: 想给朋友制作的一期刊物写文，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Develop a made-up scene carefully instead of turning friends into gossip material.
label.zh: 仔细发展虚构场景，不把朋友当八卦素材。

label.en: Let another contributor explain how the text might sit beside their image.
label.zh: 让另一创作者解释文字怎样伴图。

label.en: Choose a length that fits the space and work the group has agreed.
label.zh: 选适合版面和约好工作量的长度。

label.en: Test a handwritten or cut-paper treatment for the words.
label.zh: 给文字试手写或剪纸呈现。

prompt.en: Two contributors disagree about which page should open the issue. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 两位创作者对哪页开篇有分歧，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Hear both reasons and reflect them back without making either person the problem.
label.zh: 听两边理由并复述，不把任何人当问题。

label.en: Compare two possible orders against the same agreed constraints.
label.zh: 用同一约定限制，比两种页序。

label.en: Make quick folded mock-ups so the group can try both openings.
label.zh: 做快折样刊，让小组试两种开篇。

label.en: Keep the invitation to discuss easy and free of social ranking.
label.zh: 让讨论邀请轻松，不排名社交地位。

prompt.en: The group could make one elaborate copy or several simple copies. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 小组可作一本复杂刊或几本简单刊，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Choose after checking what people have freely offered to make and share.
label.zh: 核大家自愿制作、分享什么后再选。

label.en: Try a new handmade finish on a small sample before deciding.
label.zh: 决定前，用小样试新手作表面。

label.en: Find an easy way for friends to enjoy the issue whichever format is chosen.
label.zh: 无论选哪形式，都找朋友轻松享受的方法。

label.en: Set a clear, agreed production plan for the selected format.
label.zh: 给选定形式定清楚、约好的制作计划。

prompt.en: Your first paper fashion sketch looks different from what you imagined. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 首张纸上穿搭草图和想象不同，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Treat it as a prototype and try one concrete change in texture or shape.
label.zh: 当原型，在质地或形状试一项具体变化。

label.en: Show it informally to a friend who is welcome to react or pass.
label.zh: 随意给朋友看，欢迎回应或不评。

label.en: Check how it fits the issue’s theme before changing the whole design.
label.zh: 大改前，核怎样合这期主题。

label.en: Write a fictional note that explores the unexpected detail.
label.zh: 写虚构便笺，探索意外细节。

prompt.en: Friends can drop into the creative session at different times. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 朋友能在不同时段来创作活动，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Leave a friendly, low-pressure way to join that works for late arrivals too.
label.zh: 留友好、无压力加入方式，晚来也适用。

label.en: Keep an agreed checklist so people know which pages are ready.
label.zh: 留约好清单，让人知哪些页已好。

label.en: Offer a small fictional writing prompt that can stand on its own.
label.zh: 给可独立完成的小虚构写作引子。

label.en: Ask arrivals what sort of contribution they would actually like to make.
label.zh: 问来者实际想作哪类贡献。

prompt.en: The issue’s theme is changing as people make their pages. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 随大家制作，刊物主题也在变，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Propose an updated theme and get agreement before reorganising people’s work.
label.zh: 提更新主题，获同意再重排作品。

label.en: Write about an invented change of perspective that echoes the creative process.
label.zh: 写一个虚构视角变化，呼应创作过程。

label.en: Hear what each contributor hopes the revised theme will keep.
label.zh: 听每位创作者盼新主题保留什么。

label.en: Pick a realistic revision within the time and supplies already offered.
label.zh: 在已自愿给的时间、用品内选现实修改。

prompt.en: A short text needs a more distinctive voice for the zine. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 刊物一段短文需更独特声音，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Rewrite an invented narrator’s observations, keeping real private details out.
label.zh: 改虚构叙述者观察，排除真人隐私。

label.en: Ask a collaborator how the voice reads to them, then hear their reasons.
label.zh: 问合作者怎样读此声音，再听理由。

label.en: Choose one revision that fits the group’s agreed editing time.
label.zh: 选一项合约好编辑时间的修改。

label.en: Try lettering or paper layers that give the words another visual rhythm.
label.zh: 试字体或纸层，给文字另一视觉节奏。

prompt.en: Your friends interpret the same creative idea in opposite ways. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 朋友对同一创作点子有相反解释，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Let each explain their reading and look for a distinction worth keeping.
label.zh: 让各自解释读法，找值得保留的差别。

label.en: Compare practical versions without treating anybody’s budget as personal worth.
label.zh: 比可行版本，不把谁的预算当个人价值。

label.en: Make a reversible sample to explore the difference with my hands.
label.zh: 用可改回小样，亲手探索差别。

label.en: Keep the gathering friendly even if the final pieces remain different.
label.zh: 即使最终作品不同，聚会仍友好。

prompt.en: The group is deciding how to finish the optional zine without extra spending. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 小组决定怎样不额外花钱完成可选创作刊，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Set a small achievable scope using only agreed contributions.
label.zh: 只用约好贡献，定可完成小范围。

label.en: Turn a leftover material into a fresh handmade detail.
label.zh: 把剩材料变新手作细节。

label.en: Invite people to enjoy the finished work without a prestige contest.
label.zh: 邀请享受成品，不比赛声望。

label.en: Give the final pages a coherent order and clear closing point.
label.zh: 给最后几页连贯顺序和清楚终点。

prompt.en: After the issue is finished, you can try one new detail for next time. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 这期完成后，下次可试一项新细节，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Prototype a different paper shape or handmade styling idea.
label.zh: 给不同纸形或手作造型点子做原型。

label.en: Keep an easy invitation open to friends with different interests.
label.zh: 给兴趣不同朋友留轻松邀请。

label.en: Agree a new visual theme before building another whole issue.
label.zh: 再做整期前，约好新视觉主题。

label.en: Write a fresh invented scene rather than reusing a real disagreement.
label.zh: 写新虚构场景，不重用真人争执。
